description: This file defines the 'EscaperExtension' class for Twig, adding features related to content escaping, including filter definitions, node visitors, and strategies for escaping output in templates.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\EscaperExtension
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractExtension, providing escaping functionality, including filters, node visitors, and strategies for Twig templates.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an array of token parsers, including AutoEscapeTokenParser, used for parsing escape-related syntax.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array of node visitors, including EscaperNodeVisitor, used during compilation of the Twig AST.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig filters ('escape', 'e', 'raw') for escaping and raw output.

methods.name: setEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the Twig environment; deprecated in favor of runtime methods.

methods.name: setDefaultStrategy
methods.description: Sets the default escaping strategy, which can be a string, false, or a callable.

methods.name: getDefaultStrategy
methods.description: Returns the default escaping strategy for a given template name.

methods.name: setEscaper
methods.description: Defines a new escaper for a strategy; deprecated.

methods.name: addSafeClass
methods.description: Adds a safe class with specified strategies; deprecated.

methods.name: escapeFilterIsSafe
methods.description: Static internal method to determine if filter arguments are safe, returning safety info.
